loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Fresh validation is preferred; policy may require it for high-risk semantic gates.

next_loop.reason: The next compiler loop should start from CodeWiki source refs; the agent may refresh context when useful.

requirements.text: Parallel CodeWiki write roles default to isolated Git worktrees/branches per task and role, with an explicit solo-mode override only when safe.
A worktree factory/orchestrator prepares, records, heartbeats, verifies, and cleans builder, validator, and publisher worktrees with branch/path/base/head/tree/clean/digest metadata.

Task-close and publication use a publisher/merge queue: builders produce branch or patch refs, validators verify immutable refs from fresh worktrees, and publishers serialize final merge/commit/generated-state updates with clean proof.
Artifact wait/wake records name exact branch, patch, claim, and next safe action so sessions do not block solely on unrelated shared worktree dirtiness.

Once the isolated worktree/publisher path lands, /wiki-session-handoff compatibility cleanup should remove or extract the shim in a dedicated worktree unless an explicit migration task requires preservation.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Shared dirty worktree blockers are prevented by default.
evidence_mapping.evidence: .codewiki/kb/system/worktree-isolation.md owns default per-task role worktrees/refs and root-as-coordination/publisher semantics; api/adapters/agency reference it.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Worktree metadata is enforced by orchestration, not just recorded opportunistically.
evidence_mapping.evidence: .codewiki/kb/system/worktree-isolation.md defines factory prepare/record/heartbeat/verify/cleanup metadata; api/adapters route coordination to it.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Task close becomes controlled and proof-bearing.
evidence_mapping.evidence: .codewiki/kb/system/worktree-isolation.md, roadmap.md, and validation-gateway.md define publisher queue/result and clean immutable proof for close/publication.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Waiting agents get actionable resume state.
evidence_mapping.evidence: .codewiki/kb/system/worktree-isolation.md, api.md, adapters.md, and agency.md require exact blockers and next safe actions in wait/wake messages.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Compatibility cleanup proceeds only after safe isolation flow exists.
evidence_mapping.evidence: .codewiki/kb/system/worktree-isolation.md and TASK-005 refinement route /wiki-session-handoff cleanup after TASK-006 validates isolated worktree/publisher flow.

assumptions: Existing role/worktree metadata in the session queue can be extended into a worktree factory without replacing artifact status semantics.
Publisher queue should serialize canonical root commits and generated CodeWiki state changes.
The first implementation can support local Git worktrees before adding richer external worker adapters.
open_questions: Choose default worktree root: repo-local ignored directory, external temp directory, or configurable path.
Choose branch naming convention for task/role/session worktrees.
Decide whether publisher queue starts as application tool, Pi command, or internal agency role.
